title: Role
description: One open role at AIS — volunteer, board seat, internship or paid job. Feeds the /colabora | /collabora page and a schema.org/JobPosting JSON-LD block (only when type='paid', otherwise Google rejects it). ai-generated

id.description: kebab-case, also the anchor and the apply-email subject token

status.description: Only 'open' renders unless settings.showClosedRoles is true.

type.description: Drives the badge colour and whether JobPosting JSON-LD is emitted.

area.description: Must match an id in careers.json > areas[]

commitment.description: Hours per week / per month, in words. The single most important field for a volunteer role — put it on the card, not just the detail page.

summary.description: Two lines max. This is the card copy.

offers.description: What the volunteer gets back. Never leave this empty — it is the conversion driver.

closesAt.description: If set and past, the build flips status to 'closed'.
